question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Jaishit had written / the application / before you came.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• All parts of the given sentence are grammatically correct.
 
• The sentence is already in the correct past perfect tense.
 
• It conveys a clear meaning that 'Jaishit' had completed the task of writing the application before someone arrived.
 
• Therefore, there is 'No error' in this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Options 2, 3, and 4 are all grammatically correct in this sentence.
